# Notivexa — AI Academic Intelligence & Study Platform
> Turn your textbooks, PDFs, and video links into realistic handwritten notes, structured diagrams, Bloom's Taxonomy question papers, smart flashcards, and audio lectures.

## Overview
Notivexa is a comprehensive, production-grade AI platform specifically tailored for students and educators. It ingests academic content (PDFs, images of handwritten notes, YouTube video transcripts, and online textbook links) and automatically synthesizes high-fidelity study assets.

- **Website**: https://notivexa.com
- **Repository / Architecture**: React 18 SPA + Vite, Node.js Express backend, MongoDB, PDFKit rendering engine
- **Target Audience**: University students (MCA, B.Tech, BSc, Commerce), school students (CBSE, ICSE, State Boards), and academic educators.

## Core Capabilities & Features

### 1. Handwritten Notes Generator (`/notebook`)
- Converts dense academic text into human-like handwritten study notes.
- Includes **15 authentic handwriting fonts**:
  1. *Caveat* (Teacher Cursive)
  2. *Kalam* (Indian School Notebook)
  3. *Indie Flower* (Casual Notes)
  4. *Architects Daughter* (Technical Blueprint Print)
  5. *Patrick Hand* (Neat Student Print)
  6. *Shadows Into Light* (Delicate Cursive)
  7. *Gloria Hallelujah* (Blackboard Chalk)
  8. *Permanent Marker* (Bold Felt Marker)
  9. *Sacramento* (Elegant Script)
  10. *Courgette* (Fluid Calligraphy Italic)
  11. *Marck Script* (Fountain Pen Cursive)
  12. *Nanum Pen Script* (Fine-tip Ballpen)
  13. *Reenie Beanie* (Fast Lecture Scrawl)
  14. *Covered By Your Grace* (Pencil Print)
  15. *Rock Salt* (Expressive Marker)
- Features 5 realistic paper styles: Yellow Ruled, White Ruled, Graph / Grid Paper, Cream Plain, and Dark Blackboard.
- Strictly structured academic notes format:
  - **Title & Subtitle**
  - **Definition**: Clear single-sentence conceptual formulation.
  - **Summary**: High-level conceptual overview.
  - **In-depth Explanation**: Comprehensive bullet points covering laws, formulas, and theorems.
  - **Process Flow Diagram**: Centered vector flowchart with directional arrowheads.
  - **Practical Examples**: Real-world concrete scenarios.
- Instant server-side PDF regeneration on font switch without re-running AI inference.

### 2. Autonomous Question Paper Generator (`/notebook?tool=paper`)
- Generates exam papers mapped to **Bloom's Taxonomy Levels (BL1 to BL5)** and **Course Outcomes (CO1 to CO5)**.
- Formats:
  - **20 Marks Internal Assessment**: 1 Hour duration, Section A (MCQs/Brief) + Section B (Short Answers).
  - **60 Marks End Semester Examination**: 2 Hours duration, Question 1 Compulsory + choice between Q2 through Q6 (15 Marks each).
  - Generates up to 5 randomized question paper sets with complete answer keys.

### 3. Flashcard Studio (`/flashcards`)
- Automatic generation of concept flashcards with difficulty grading (Easy, Medium, Hard).
- Interactive flip interface, mastery tracking, and spaced repetition readiness.

### 4. Audio Lectures & Podcast Synthesis (`/podcast`)
- Converts chapters into conversational 2-person or teacher-led spoken audio lectures.
- High-fidelity neural voice synthesis with Indian English and vernacular accent support.

### 5. Ask Your PDF — Contextual AI Tutor (`/chatbot`)
- RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) query system grounded exclusively in the uploaded document.
- Answers step-by-step mathematical derivations, definitions, and code walkthroughs with zero hallucinations.

### 6. Study Planner & Exam Countdown (`/planner`)
- Automated timetable generation based on exam date, available daily study hours, and subject difficulty weighting.
- Integrated curated high-yield questions for core computer science & science subjects.

### 7. Free Textbook & Video Library (`/ebooks`)
- Curated index of official academic textbooks (NCERT, Let Us C, CLRS, Galvin OS, Tanenbaum Networks) and top YouTube lecture playlists.

## Clean URL Slugs
- `/dashboard`: Main student portal and study statistics
- `/upload`: Multi-file PDF, camera capture, and YouTube/web link importer
- `/notebook`: Multi-tool study asset generator (Handwritten notes, Question Papers, Slides, Mindmaps)
- `/flashcards`: Flip-card study studio
- `/podcast`: Audio lecture player and script generator
- `/chatbot`: Document chat tutor
- `/library`: Personal archive of uploaded and generated files
- `/ebooks`: Free textbooks and video library
- `/planner`: Personalized exam prep schedule
- `/settings`: Account, appearance theme, and profile settings
- `/login`: Secure user authentication
- `/register`: Student and teacher onboarding
- `/404`: Dedicated 404 error handler with site navigation

## Technical Implementation
- **Frontend**: Vite 5, React 18, React Router v6, KaTeX mathematical typesetting, Remark/Rehype Markdown.
- **Backend**: Node.js, Express, PDFKit with precision coordinate grid and vector graphics, FFmpeg multimedia rendering, Google Gemini & Groq AI APIs.
- **Licensing & Access**: Free for students worldwide with specialized optimizations for Indian curricula.
